_comment: Coordinate rounding shared by the phone (src/pkjs/weather/coords.js, test/coords.test.js) and the rainbow-nowcast proxy (body.ts, body_test.ts): [input, rounded]. Both sides must agree, or an old GET and a new POST from the same fix land in different cache rows. Half-points round toward +Infinity (Math.round), never away from zero (toFixed); -0 comes back as 0.
